title: Wall Street's best week since April 2025: S&P 500 jumps 5.6% and Nasdaq 6.7% as AI stocks rebound
short: Wall Street bounces back: S&P 500 +5.6%, Nasdaq +6.7% in a week
dek: A week after their worst drop in 18 months, US stocks posted their biggest weekly gain since April 2025 as Nvidia's CEO drama eased and chip stocks recovered. A December Fed hike is now almost fully priced in.
card: The S&P 500 rose 5.6% and the Dow had its best week in four years. What the rebound means for India on Monday.
